expertDashboard_faq-section.faqSubtitle: Ibyo wifuza kumenya byose ku bijyanye no gufata gahunda, kwishyura n'abavoka bacu.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq1a: Shakisha umwavoka wifuza, hitamo serivisi y'amategeko n'igihe kikunogeye, hanyuma wemeze. Uhita wohererezwa ubutumwa bugufi kuri SMS na imeli byemeza gahunda yawe.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq2q: Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kwishyura mwemera?
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq2a: Twemera MTN Mobile Money na Airtel Money. Amafaranga yawe arindwa neza na MyJudicial kugeza igihe inama irangiye, akaba aribwo ahabwa umwavoka.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq3q: Ese abavoka bose bari hano barazewe?
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq3a: Yego rwose. Buri mwavoka wose uri kuri MyJudicial yemejwe n'Urugaga rw'Abavoka mu Rwanda (Rwanda Bar Association) kandi umwirondoro we waragenzuwe mbere yo gushyirwa ku rubuga.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq4q: Ese inama z'amategeko zishobora kubera kuri interineti?
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq4a: Yego cyane. Abavoka benshi batanga inama binyuze kuri videwo, kuri terefone cyangwa guhurira ku biro byabo. Uhitamo uburyo bukunogeye igihe ufata gahunda.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq5q: Ese nshobora guhindura umunsi cyangwa gusiba gahunda?
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq5a: Yego. Urashobora guhindura umunsi cyangwa gusiba gahunda mbere y'amasaha 24 ngo inama ibe binyuze kuri konti yawe ya MyJudicial.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq6q: Ese amafaranga yanjye ararindwa igihe umwavoka atabonetse?
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq6a: Ijana ku ijana. Amafaranga yose abikwa mu mutekano kugeza inama ibaye. Iyo umwavoka atabonetse ku mpamvu iyo ari yo yose, uhita uyasubizwa yose nta kiguzi waciwe.
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq7q: Ni gute nishyura nkoresheje Mobile Money?
expertDashboard_faq-section.faq7a: Iyo wemeje gufata gahunda, uhita ubona ubutumwa bukubaza kwemeza kwishyura kuri terefone yawe. Shyiramo umubare w'ibanga wawe (PIN) kugira ngo wishyure ako kanya.

emptyState.noResults: Nta kibazo gihuye n'ibyo ushakishije cyabonetse.

item1.q: Mbona nte kandi ngafata nte umwanya n'umuvugizi w'amategeko wemewe kuri MyJudicial?
item1.a: Shakisha mu rutonde rwacu ukurikije ubwoko bw'ikibazo, ururimi cyangwa aho aherereye, cyangwa usobanurire Umufasha wacu wa AI. Hitamo umuvugizi, uhitemo isaha ikunogeye, hanyuma wishyure mu buryo burinzwe bwa escrow.

item2.q: Abavugizi b'amategeko bakoresha izihe ndimi kuri MyJudicial?
item2.a: Abavugizi bose bavuga nibura indimi ebyiri mu ndimi zemewe mu mategeko y'u Rwanda. Ushobora gushungura ugahitamo umuvugizi ukoresha Ikinyarwanda, Icyongereza cyangwa Igifaransa.

item3.q: Mba muri Diaspora. Ese nshobora kugisha inama umuvugizi ku bibazo by'ubutaka, izungura cyangwa ubucuruzi?
item3.a: Yego rwose. Ushobora kwishyura ukoresheje ikarita mpuzamahanga (Visa/Mastercard), guhitamo isaha ihuye n'aho uri, no guhura n'umuvugizi kuri videwo y'ibanga mugasuzuma icyemezo cy'ubutaka UPI n'amasezerano.

item4.q: Ese nkeneye gukuramo Zoom, Teams cyangwa indi porogaramu kugira ngo njye mu nama ya videwo?
item4.a: Oya rwose. Icyumba cyacu cy'inama gikora 100% muri porogaramu isanzwe usomeraho imbuga za interineti hifashishijwe LiveKit WebRTC. Ntibisaba gukuramo indi porogaramu kuri telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa.

item5.q: Ese umuvugizi ashobora kunkurikirana mu rukiko nyuma y'inama twagiranye kuri interineti?
item5.a: Yego cyane. Konsiltasiyo iba intambwe yo gusuzuma ikibazo. Iyo kigiye mu rukiko, umuvugizi aguha amasezerano yo kunganirwa (convention d'honoraires) n'inyandiko y'ububasha (procuration) yo kukuburanira mu nkiko z'u Rwanda binyuze muri IECMS.

item6.q: Ese abavugizi b'amategeko bakira bate amafaranga ya konsiltasiyo?
item6.a: Kwakira ubwishyu byikora kandi birizewe 100%. Iyo usoje inama ukanatanga incamake y'imyanzuro, amafaranga yari abitswe muri escrow ahita yoherezwa ako kanya kuri MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money cyangwa kuri banki yawe mu Rwanda.

item7.q: Ese umuvugizi agumana uburenganzira bwo kwishyiriraho ibiciro n'amasaha akoreraho?
item7.a: Yego cyane. Mu kubahiriza amahame y'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi mu Rwanda, buri muvugizi yigenga mu gushyiraho ibiciro by'ubujyanama n'amasaha abonekeraho. MyJudicial ntigena ibiciro cyangwa ngo igutegeke uko ukora.

item8.q: Bagenzura bate ko umuvugizi ari umunyamuryango wemewe w'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi (RBA)?
item8.a: Buri muvugizi agenzurwa ko yanditse ku Rutonde rw'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi mu Rwanda, akagenzurirwa uruhushya rwo gukora n'indangamuntu mbere y'uko konti ye yemezwa ku rubuga.

item9.q: Bigenda bite iyo umukiriya atitabiriye inama ku gihe mwapanze?
item9.a: Umwanya wawe urarinzwe. Iyo umukiriya ataje mu nama kandi atabimenyesheje nibura amasaha 24 mbere, amafaranga yari abitswe muri escrow ahabwa umuvugizi hakurikijwe amabwiriza yo guhagarika inama.

item10.q: Uburyo bwa escrow burinda bute amafaranga yanjye?
item10.a: Iyo wishe, amafaranga yawe abikwa kuri konti yizewe ya escrow. Umuvugizi yishyurwa gusa ari uko inama irangiye neza. Inama nihagarikwa cyangwa umuvugizi ntaze, amafaranga yawe uyasubizwa yose.

item11.q: Ni ubuhe buryo bwo kwishyura bwemewe kuri MyJudicial?
item11.a: Twemera MTN Mobile Money na Airtel Money ku bakiriya bo mu Rwanda, ndetse n'amakarita ya Visa na Mastercard ku bakiriya bo mu Rwanda no mu mahanga.

item12.q: Ese hari andi mafaranga y'inyongera cyangwa ay'uburiganya acibwa?
item12.a: Oya rwose. Igiciro ubona ku mwirondoro w'umuvugizi ni cyo cyonyine wishyura. Nta yandi mafaranga y'ubwishingizi cyangwa ay'ubufatabuguzi acibwa mu ibanga.

item13.q: Amabwiriza yo guhagarika inama no gusubizwa amafaranga ateye ate?
item13.a: Ushobora guhindura igihe cyangwa guhagarika inama ugasubizwa amafaranga yawe yose mbere y'amasaha 24 y'inama. Iyo umuvugizi atabonetse, umukiriya ahita asubizwa amafaranga ye 100% ako kanya.

item14.q: Ese abavugizi bose bari kuri MyJudicial bemewe n'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi mu Rwanda?
item14.a: Yego. Buri muvugizi wese uri kuri MyJudicial agenzurwa ku Rutonde rw'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi mu Rwanda (RBA). Ntidushobora kwemerera umuntu utemewe gutanga ubujyanama mu mategeko.

item15.q: Ese ibiganiro by'inama birafatwa mu majwi cyangwa amashusho na porogaramu?
item15.a: Oya rwose. Ntitwigera dufata amajwi cyangwa amashusho y'inama. Itumanaho ryose rikoresha ikoranabuhanga ry'ibanga rya WebRTC kugira ngo ibanga ry'umwuga w'amategeko ryubahirizwe 100%.

item16.q: MyJudicial yubahiriza ite Itegeko ry'u Rwanda No. 058/2021 ryerekeye kurinda amakuru bwite?
item16.a: Amakuru yose n'inyandiko zishyirwaho birindwa mu buryo bukomeye hakurikijwe Itegeko No. 058/2021. Umuvugizi wahisemo wenyine ni we ufite uburenganzira bwo kureba inyandiko z'ikibazo cyawe mu ibanga.

faqs.clientSubtitle: Ibintu byose ukwiye kumenya ku bijyanye no gutegura, gufata umwanya no kugisha inama umuvugizi.
faqs.advocateSubtitle: Ibintu byose abanyamwuga mu by'amategeko bakeneye kumenya ku bijyanye no gukora, kwakira amafaranga n'amahame y'umwuga.
faqs.clientQ1: Mba muri Diaspora (Amerika, Uburayi, EAC). Ese nshobora kugisha inama umuvugizi ku bibazo by'ubutaka cyangwa ubucuruzi mu Rwanda?
faqs.clientA1: Yego rwose. Abakiriya bacu benshi baba mu mahanga (diaspora). Ushobora kwishyura ukoresheje amakarita mpuzamahanga (Visa/Mastercard), guhitamo isaha ihuye n'isaha y'aho uherereye, no guhura n'umuvugizi binyuze kuri videwo yacu y'ibanga mugasuzuma icyemezo cy'ubutaka UPI, amasezerano y'ubucuruzi, cyangwa iby'izungura.
faqs.clientQ2: Abavugizi b'amategeko bakoresha izihe ndimi kuri MyJudicial?
faqs.clientA2: Abavugizi bose bari kuri MyJudicial bavuga nibura indimi ebyiri mu ndimi zemewe mu mategeko y'u Rwanda. Ushobora gushungura ugahitamo umuvugizi ukoresha Ikinyarwanda, Icyongereza cyangwa Igifaransa, kugira ngo usobanure ikibazo cyawe mu rurimi wumva neza kurusha izindi.
faqs.clientQ3: Ese nkeneye gukuramo Zoom, Teams cyangwa indi porogaramu kugira ngo njye mu nama?
faqs.clientA3: Oya rwose. Icyumba cyacu cy'inama gikora 100% muri porogaramu isanzwe usomeraho imbuga za interineti (Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge) hifashishijwe LiveKit WebRTC. Ntibisaba gushyiramo porogaramu nshya cyangwa gufungura indi konti kuri telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa yawe.
faqs.clientQ4: Ese guhamagara kuri telefoni isanzwe bikora bite niba nta murandasi mfite?
faqs.clientA4: Niba wahisemo uburyo bwo guhamagarwa kuri telefoni (Phone Consultation), ntusabwa kugira murandasi. Ku isaha mwapanze, umuvugizi w'amategeko aguhamagara ako kanya kuri nimero yawe ya MTN cyangwa Airtel watanze ubwo wafataga umwanya.
faqs.clientQ5: Ese nshobora kohereza inyandiko z'ubutaka (UPI), amasezerano cyangwa impapuro z'urukiko mbere y'inama?
faqs.clientA5: Yego. Mu gihe wuzuza ibisabwa, ushobora gushyiraho inyandiko za PDF cyangwa amafoto y'ibyangombwa byawe mu buryo bw'ibanga rikomeye. Umuvugizi abisoma mbere y'uko inama itangira kugira ngo aze yiteguye neza aho gutakaza iminota y'inama asoma inyandiko.
faqs.clientQ6: Ese umuvugizi ashobora kunkurikirana mu rukiko nyuma y'inama twagiranye kuri interineti?
faqs.clientA6: Yego cyane. Konsiltasiyo ni yo ifungura amarembo yo kunganirwa mu buryo bwuzuye. Niba ikibazo cyawe kigomba kugezwa mu rukiko cyangwa kigakenera amasezerano akomeye, umuvugizi azaguha amasezerano yo kunganirwa (convention d'honoraires) n'inyandiko y'ububasha (procuration) yo kukuburanira mu nkiko z'u Rwanda binyuze muri IECMS.
faqs.advocateQ1: Ese abavugizi b'amategeko bakira bate amafaranga yishyuwe na ba mukiriya?
faqs.advocateA1: Kwakira ubwishyu byikora kandi birizewe 100%. Iyo usoje inama ukanatanga incamake y'imyanzuro, amafaranga yari abitswe muri escrow ahita yoherezwa ako kanya kuri MTN Mobile Money, Airtel Money cyangwa kuri konti yawe ya banki mu Rwanda—nta birarane cyangwa gukurikirana umukiriya.
faqs.advocateQ2: Ese umuvugizi agumana uburenganzira bwo kwishyiriraho ibiciro n'amasaha akoreraho?
faqs.advocateA2: Yego cyane. Mu kubahiriza amahame y'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi mu Rwanda, buri muvugizi yigenga mu gushyiraho ibiciro by'ubujyanama n'amasaha abonekeraho. MyJudicial ntigena ibiciro cyangwa ngo igutegeke uko ukora.
faqs.advocateQ3: Bagenzura bate ko umuvugizi ari umunyamuryango wemewe w'Urugaga (RBA)?
faqs.advocateA3: Buri muvugizi agen Cardano yanditse ku Rutonde rw'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi mu Rwanda, akagenzurirwa uruhushya rwo gukora n'indangamuntu mbere y'uko konti ye yemezwa ku rubuga.
faqs.advocateQ4: Ese konsiltasiyo yo kuri murandasi ishobora kuvamo kunganira umukiriya mu nkiko z'u Rwanda?
faqs.advocateA4: Yego rwose. Konsiltasiyo iba intambwe yo gusuzuma ikibazo. Iyo kigiye mu nkiko cyangwa kigakenera amasezerano, mukora amasezerano yo kunganirwa (convention d'honoraires) n'inyandiko y'ububasha (procuration) ukamuburanira mu nkiko z'u Rwanda binyuze muri IECMS.
faqs.advocateQ5: Bigenda bite iyo umukiriya atitabiriye inama ku gihe mwapanze?
faqs.advocateA5: Umwanya wawe urarinzwe. Iyo umukiriya ataje mu nama kandi atabimenyesheje nibura amasaha 24 mbere, amafaranga yari abitswe muri escrow ahabwa umuvugizi hakurikijwe amabwiriza yo guhagarika inama.
faqs.advocateQ6: Umutekano n'ibanga ry'akazi by'umuvugizi birindwa bite kuri MyJudicial?
faqs.advocateA6: Itumanaho ryose rya videwo n'amajwi rikoresha ikoranabuhanga rya WebRTC rifite umutekano w'ibanga wa 256-bit nta muntu ubangikanya cyangwa ngo rifatwe amajwi. Amakuru y'amadosiye arindwa hakurikijwe Itegeko No. 058/2021 ryerekeye kurinda amakuru bwite n'amahame y'Urugaga rw'Abavugizi.

sections.title: 1. Intangiriro n'Ibyo Aya Mabwiriza Agenga
sections.text:
MyJudicial Ltd (« MyJudicial », « twe », cyangwa « twebwe ») iyoboye ihuriro ry'ikoranabuhanga mu by'amategeko mu Rwanda, rihuza abaturage, abashoramari n'ibigo bitandukanye n'abunganizi mu mategeko bemewe kandi bagenzuwe.

Aya mabwiriza yerekeye Kuki (Cookie Policy) asobanura uburyo n'impamvu dukoresha kuki za HTTP, ububiko bwa porogaramu y'imbuga (localStorage), ububiko bw'igihe gito (sessionStorage) n'ubundi buryo bufitanye isano igihe usuye urubuga rwacu (myjudicial.com) cyangwa ukoresha serivisi zacu. Aya mabwiriza yashyizweho hakurikijwe Itegeko nº 058/2021 ryerekeye kurinda amakuru bwite n'ubuzima bwite bw'umuntu mu Rwanda.

Imbibi z'aya mabwiriza: Iyi nyandiko igenga by'umwihariko kuki n'ububiko bwa mudasobwa cyangwa terefone yawe. Ku bindi bisobanuro birambuye by'uburyo dufata, dukoresha, kandi turinda amakuru yawe muri rusange, reba Politiki y'Ibanga (Privacy Policy).

sections.title: 2. Kuki n'Ubundi Bubiko bwa Browser ni Iki?
sections.text:
Imbuga za interineti zigezweho zikoresha uburyo butandukanye bwo kubika amakuru muri mudasobwa cyangwa terefone yawe kugira ngo zikore neza kandi mu mutekano:

• Kuki za HTTP (HTTP Cookies): Dosiye nto zirimo inyuguti n'imibare zibikwa muri mudasobwa cyangwa terefone yawe na seriveri y'urubuga. Iyo winjiye ku zindi paji cyangwa ugarutse nyuma, browser yoherereza iyo kuki urubuga kugira ngo rukumenye kandi rugufashe kwinjira mu mutekano.
• Ububiko bwa HTML5 (localStorage): Uburyo buhoraho bwo kubika amakuru ku gikoresho cyawe. Bukoreshwa mu kwibuka amahitamo yawe (nk'ururimi wifuza cyangwa uko urubuga rugaragara: umweru cyangwa umukara) bitiriwe byoherezwa mu butumwa bwa interineti buri kanya.
• Ububiko bw'Igihe Gito (sessionStorage): Ububiko bumara igihe gito gusa igihe paji yawe ifunguye. Iyo ufunze paji ya browser, ayo makuru ahita asibama ako kanya.

sections.title: 3. Intego Yacu Nkuru: Nta Kukurikirana cyangwa Kuki z'Ubucuruzi
sections.text:
Mu buryo butandukanye n'izindi mbuga z'ubucuruzi, MyJudicial yubatswe hashingiwe ku ibanga rikomeye ry'akazi k'amategeko:

• NTA Kukurikirana kw'Abandi (Zero Third-Party Tracking): Ntidukoresha Google Analytics, Meta Pixel, cyangwa utundi dukoreshoสอง two kukurikirana amateka yawe kuri interineti. Ibyo ushakisha ntabwo bikurikiranwa.
• NTA Kuki zo Kwamamaza (No Advertising Cookies): Ntidukorana n'amasosiyete yamamaza cyangwa acuruza amakuru y'abantu ngo ashyire kuki ku bikoresho byanyu. Ntitugurisha cyangwa ngo ducuruze amakuru y'abakoresha urubuga.
• Umutekano kuva mu Ntango (Privacy by Design): Serivisi zose z'urubuga—harimo n'ikarita yerekana aho abunganizi bakorera hamwe n'ibiganiro bya videwo—zikoresha ikoranabuhanga ryigenga ritarinda gushyiraho kuki zikurikira abantu.

sections.title: 4. Ibyiciro by'Ikoranabuhanga Dukoresha
sections.text:
MyJudicial ikoresha ibyiciro bitatu gusa by'ibanze kandi bikenewe cyane:

• Ikoranabuhanga Rikenewe Byanze Bikunze: Rikenewe kugira ngo urubuga rukore, umukoresha abashe kwinjira mu konti ye mu mutekano, no gukumira ibitero by'ikoranabuhanga. Hatari iri koranabuhanga, kwinjira muri konti cyangwa gufata gahunda yo kugisha inama ntibyakorwa.
• Ikoranabuhanga ry'Amahitamo n'Ururimi: Rituma urubuga rwibuka ibyo wahisemo—nk'ururimi ukunda (Icyongereza, Igifaransa, cyangwa Ikinyarwanda), uko urubuga rugaragara (Urumuri cyangwa Umwijima), n'isaha y'aho uri igihe ufata gahunda.
• Ikoranabuhanga ry'Imikorere y'Igihe Gito: Ribika by'agateganyo aho wari ugeze—nko kwibuka niba menu ifunguye cyangwa kubika by'agateganyo amakuru y'umwirondoro w'umwunganizi igihe yiyandikisha kugira ngo adatakara mu gihe urubuga rwaba runyeganyeze.

sections.title: 5. Imbonerahamwe ya Kuki zose za HTTP Dukoresha
sections.text: Imbonerahamwe ikurikira irerekana kuki zose za HTTP zikoreshwa na MyJudicial n'impamvu zazo:

rows: Igomba kubika umwirondoro w'uwazindutse muri konti; irimo JWT ibitse nomero y'umukoresha, inshingano ze n'uburenganzira bwo gukoresha serivisi.
Umubare w'ibanga urinda ifishi yo kwinjira ibitero by'ubujura bwa interineti (CSRF).
Yibuka paji washakaga kureba mbere yo kwinjira muri konti kugira ngo uhite uyisubizwaho umaze kwinjira.
Ibika ururimi wahisemo (Icyongereza, Igifaransa, cyangwa Ikinyarwanda) kugira ngo urubuga ruzakomeze kurukwereka.
Yibuka niba menu y'ubugenzuzi bwa dashboard ifunze cyangwa ifunguye.

sections.title: 6. Imbonerahamwe y'Ubundi Bubiko (LocalStorage na SessionStorage)
sections.text: Imbonerahamwe ikurikira irerekana amakuru abikwa muri mudasobwa cyangwa terefone yawe ku buryo bwa LocalStorage na SessionStorage:

rows: Ibika niba ukoresha urubuga rufite amabara y'urumuri, umwijima, cyangwa uko mudasobwa yawe iteye (next-themes).
Ibika mu buryo bwihuse kode y'ururimi wahisemo kugira ngo ikoreshwe mu kumenya ibyo ubaza n'ubusemuzi bwa AI.
Ibika isaha y'aho uherereye (muri rusange Africa/Kigali) kugira ngo iminsi n'amasaha yo kugisha inama byerekanwe neza.
Bibika by'agateganyo amakuru y'umwunganizi uri kwiyandikisha kugira ngo adatakara niba paji yakunze guhita yifunga.
Bibika by'agateganyo urufunguzo rw'ikoranabuhanga ryo kwaka amakuru kuri seriveri; bihita bisibwa ako kanya iyo usotse muri konti.

sections.title: 7. Serivisi z'Abandi n'Ikoranabuhanga Ridafite Kuki z'Ubujura
sections.text:
Tugenzura serivisi zose zifashishwa n'urubuga rwacu kugira ngo twemeze ko nta kuki zikurikira abantu zishyirwa ku bikoresho byanyu:

• Amakarita ya MapLibre GL: Amakarita yerekana aho abunganizi bakorera akoresha MapLibre GL idakoresha kuki za Google Maps cyangwa izo gukurikirana za Mapbox.
• Videwo zo Kugisha Inama za LiveKit WebRTC: Ibiganiro bya videwo bikorwa binyuze kuri LiveKit Cloud ikoresha uburyo bufunze cyane kandi bwizewe bw'ibanga (encryption). LiveKit ntishyira kuki zikurikira abantu ku bikoresho byanyu.
• Ubwenge bw'Ikoranabuhanga (AI) mu Gusuzuma Ibibazo: Ibyo mubaza bisuzumirwa muri seriveri zacu zizewe gusa. Nta kuki zo kwamamaza cyangwa gukurikirana zikoreshwa.
• Supabase mu Gutanga Ubutumwa Ako Kanya: Ikoreshwa gusa mu kohereza ubutumwa ako kanya nta kuki z'abandi zibitswe.

sections.title: 8. Ishingiro ry'Amategeko n'Uruhushya Hakurikijwe Itegeko Nº 058/2021
sections.text:
Ishingiro rishingiye ku Mategeko: Dukurikije ingingo ya 46 y'Itegeko nº 058/2021, gukoresha kuki zikenewe byanze bikunze bishingira ku Masezerano hagati yacu nawe (ingingo ya 46(1)(b)) no ku Nyungu Zifitiye Umumaro Urubuga (ingingo ya 46(1)(f)) hagamijwe kurinda umutekano w'urubuga, kwinjira neza muri konti no gukumira uburiganya.

Amahitamo y'Umukoresha: Kuki z'amahitamo (nk'ururimi cyangwa uko urubuga rugaragara) zibikwa gusa kuko ari wowe ubyihitiyemo ku bushake.

Impamvu Nta Butumwa Bubuza (Banner) Bwerekanwa: Kubera ko MyJudicial IDAKORESHA na gato kuki zo kwamamaza, kukurikirana amateka y'abantu cyangwa gukusanya amakuru y'abandi, amategeko y'u Rwanda n'ay'amahanga ntabwo ategeka ko dushyiraho akadirishya gakumira paji (cookie banner). Nihagira ikoranabuhanga ryo kwamamaza ryongerwamo mu gihe kizaza, tuzabanza kubaha uburenganzira bwo kubyemera cyangwa kubyanga mbere y'uko kuki zishyirwaho.

sections.title: 9. Uko Wacunga, Wasuzuma cyangwa Wahagarika Kuki muri Browser Yawe
sections.text:
Ufite uburenganzira bwose n'ubushobozi bwo kugenzura kuki ziri ku gikoresho cyawe. Porogaramu zose zifashishwa mu gusura interineti zifite uburyo bwo gusuzuma, guhagarika cyangwa gusiba kuki:

• Google Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Third-party cookies → See all site data and permissions.
• Mozilla Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data → Manage Data.
• Apple Safari: Settings → Safari → Advanced → Privacy → Block all cookies.
• Microsoft Edge: Settings → Cookies and site permissions → Manage and delete cookies and site data.

Ibizaba Iyo Uhagaritse Kuki: Nuhagarika kuki zose, ntuzabasha kwinjira muri konti yawe ya MyJudicial, ntuzabasha gufata gahunda yo kugisha inama cyangwa kwishyura. Gusa gusura urubuga no gushakisha abunganizi ku mugaragaro bizakomeza gukora.

sections.title: 10. Impinduka kuri Aya Mabwiriza
sections.text:
Dushobora kuvugurura aya mabwiriza igihe habayeho impinduka mu ikoranabuhanga dukoresha cyangwa mu mategeko y'u Rwanda agenga ubuzima bwite. Igihe bibaye, itariki y'« Iheruka kuvugururwa » iri hejuru kuri iyi paji izahita ivugururwa.

Turabashishikariza kujya musoma aya mabwiriza kenshi kugira ngo mumenye uburyo turinda amakuru yanyu mu buhanga bw'ikoranabuhanga.

content.intro: MyJudicial Ltd ("MyJudicial", "twebwe", cyangwa "byacu") yubaha uburenganzira bwawe shingiro bw'ubuzima bwite kandi yiyemeje kubungabunga umutekano w'amakuru yawe bwite. Iyi Politiki y'Ibanga ikumenyesha uburyo dukusanya, dutunganya, tubika kandi turinda amakuru yawe igihe ukoresha urubuga rwacu rwa serivisi z'amategeko (myjudicial.com), ikanasobanura uburenganzira bwite uhabwa n'Itegeko ry'u Rwanda nº 058/2021 ryo ku wa 13/10/2021 ryerekeye kurinda amakuru bwite n'ubuzima bwite bw'umuntu.

sections.title: 1. Abo turi bo n'Ushinzwe Kugenzura Amakuru
sections.text:
MyJudicial Ltd ("MyJudicial", "twebwe", cyangwa "byacu") ni urubuga rw'ikoranabuhanga rya mbere mu Rwanda ruhuza abaturage, abashoramari n'inzego z'ubucuruzi n'abavoka n'impuguke mu by'amategeko bemewe kandi bagenzuwe. Mu rwego rw'Itegeko nº 058/2021 ryo ku wa 13/10/2021 ryerekeye kurinda amakuru bwite n'ubuzima bwite bw'umuntu, MyJudicial niyo igenzura amakuru (Data Controller) atunganywa binyuze ku rubuga rwacu (myjudicial.com) na serivisi zijyanye na rwo.

Ibiro bikuru byacu biherereye kuri {{officeAddress}} ({{poBox}}). Twashyizeho Umukozi ushinzwe Kurinda Amakuru (DPO) ushobora kubonwa kuri imeri {{dpoEmail}} ku bibazo byose byerekeye uburenganzira bwite n'iyubahirizwa ry'amategeko.

sections.title: 2. Ibyo Iyi Politiki Ireba
3. Amakuru Dukusanya
sections.text:
Dukusanya gusa amakuru bwite akenewe kugira ngo dusohoze inshingano z'urubuga rwacu. Amakuru akusanywa agabanyije muri ibi byiciro bikurikira:

• Amakuru y'Umwirondoro no Kwinjira: Amazina nyakuri, imeri, nimero ya telefoni, ijambobanga rifunze (Argon2/bcrypt), konti za Google/LinkedIn zikoreshwa mu kwinjira, ururimi uhitamo, n'icyiciro cyawe (Umuturage, Impuguke, Umuyobozi).
• Amakuru y'Umwuga w'Abavoka: Amazina akoresha mu mwuga, amateka y'akazi, ibiro akoreramo, aderesi, nimero yo mu Rugaga rw'Abavoka (RBA Roll), icyemezo cyo gukora ubuvoka gifite agaciro, kopi y'indangamuntu cyangwa pasiporo, impamyabumenyi, ibyiciro by'amategeko akoreramo, ibiciro by'ubujyanama, na nimero ya Mobile Money yishyurirwaho.
• Amakuru yo Guhura n'Ubujyanama: Ubwoko bwa serivisi, uburyo bwo guhura (amashusho, telefoni, guhura imbona nkubone), itariki n'isaha, inyandiko ngufi z'ikibazo, nimero y'icyumba cyo guhuriramo (meeting room ID), n'amateka yo gusubika cyangwa guhagarika.
• Ubutumwa Bwo ku Rubuga: Ubutumwa bwandikiranwa hagati y'umukiriya n'umwunganizi, inyandiko zometseho (PDF, amasezerano, inyandiko z'urukiko), n'igihe ubutumwa bwagereye n'aho bwasomewe.
• Inyandiko zo mu Bubiko Bw'Ibanga: Inyandiko z'imanza, amasezerano, n'ibimenyetso bishyirwa mu bubiko bw'ikoranabuhanga (Vault) bwo muri OCI, bikaba bifunze n'ingufuri ya AES-256-GCM ku buryo nta wundi ushobora kubibona.
• Amakuru y'Imari n'Ubwishyu: Nimero z'ubwishyu (txRef), nimero zikoreshwa muri MTN Mobile Money na Airtel Money binyuze muri AzamPay, amafaranga yabitswe muri escrow, n'amafaranga yishyuwe umwavoka. MyJudicial NTIBIKA nimero z'amakarita ya banki cyangwa imibare y'ibanga (PIN) ya Mobile Money.
• Amakuru y'Ubusesenguzi bwa AI: Ibisobanuro by'ikibazo byanditswe cyangwa byavuzwe mu ijwi, inyandiko yakuwe mu ijwi ikorwa mu kanya gato, ubwoko bw'amategeko ikibazo kibarizwamo, ubwihutirwe, n'ingengo y'imari igenekerejwe.
• Amakuru y'Aho Uherereye: Imyirondoro y'aho uherereye (GPS) isabwa gusa igihe ushaka abavoka bakwegereye ku ikarita (iyo bidakozwe hafatwa Kigali CBD: -1.9441, 30.0619); n'aho ibiro by'abavoka biherereye.
• Amakuru y'Ikoranabuhanga na Raporo z'Umutekano: Aderesi ya IP, amakuru ya porogaramu ukoresha (browser), igihe winjiriye, na raporo z'umutekano (AuditLog) zigaragaza ibikorwa bikomeye byakozwe ku rubuga.

sections.title: 4. Uko Dukusanya Amakuru Yawe
sections.text:
Dukusanya amakuru bwite binyuze mu buryo busobanutse kandi bwemewe n'amategeko:

• Utwibwiriye ubwawe: Igihe wiyandikisha ku rubuga, wuzuza imyirondoro, usobanura ikibazo cyawe mu ifishi, ushyira inyandiko mu bubiko, wandikira umwunganizi, cyangwa wishyura ubujyanama.
• Bikozwe n'ikoranabuhanga mu buryo bwikora: Mu gihe ukoresha urubuga, dukusanya amakuru y'ibanze y'ikoranabuhanga (cookies, aderesi ya IP, amakuru ya mudasobwa cyangwa telefoni) kugira ngo urubuga rukore neza kandi rufite umutekano.
• Amakuru atangwa n'abavoka: Igihe abavoka basaba gukorera kuri MyJudicial, batanga ibyangombwa by'umwuga, impamyabumenyi, n'amasaha babonekaho.
• Igenzura ry'inzego zibifitiye ububasha: Itsinda ryacu rishinzwe igenzura risuzuma ibyangombwa byatanzwe ribigereranya n'Urutonde rw'Abavoka bemewe rwatangajwe n'Urugaga rw'Abavoka mu Rwanda.

sections.title: 5. Impamvu n'Uburyo Dukoresha Amakuru Yawe
sections.text:
MyJudicial ikoresha amakuru bwite ku mpamvu zizwi, zemewe n'amategeko kandi zisobanutse neza gusa:

• Gucunga urubuga no gufasha abakoresha kwinjira: Kwandika abakoresha bashya, gucunga imyirondoro, no kugenzura uburenganzira bw'abinjira muri buri cyiciro.
• Kugenzura abavoka no kurinda uburiganya: Gusuzuma niba umwavoka yanditse mu Rugaga, kurinda ko hari abiyitirira ubuvoka, no kurengera abaturage bashaka ubutabera.
• Gutegura gahunda z'ubujyanama no guhura mu buryo bw'amashusho: Gushyiraho gahunda yo guhura, guhuza za kalendari, no gufungura ibyumba by'amashusho byizewe (LiveKit).
• Gucunga amafaranga mu buryo bwizewe (Escrow): Kubika amafaranga y'ubujyanama kugeza serivisi irangiye neza, no kuyashyikiriza umwavoka kuri Mobile Money.
• Serivisi y'Ububiko bw'Inyandiko z'Ibanga (Vault): Kubika mu buryo bufunze kandi bwizewe inyandiko z'imanza n'amasezerano muri OCI.
• Gusesengura ikibazo no gushaka abavoka bakwiye hifashishijwe AI: Gutahura mu kanya gato urwego rw'amategeko ikibazo kibarizwamo, ubwihutirwe, no kumenya abavoka babyigiye.
• Kohereza ubutumwa bw'ingenzi bwa serivisi: Kohereza ubutumwa bubutsa gahunda, imibare y'umutekano (OTP), inyemezabwishyu n'ubutumwa bwa serivisi binyuze kuri SMS na imeri (Brevo).
• Umutekano w'urubuga, kugenzura ibikorwa no kubahiriza amategeko: Gutahura ibitero by'ikoranabuhanga, gukemura impaka, kubika raporo z'umutekano (AuditLog), no gutanga raporo ziteganywa n'amategeko y'u Rwanda.

sections.title: 6. Ishingiro ry'Amategeko ryo Gutunganya Amakuru (Itegeko nº 058/2021)
sections.text:
Hifashishijwe Ingingo ya 46 y'Itegeko ry'u Rwanda nº 058/2021 ryerekeye kurinda amakuru bwite n'ubuzima bwite bw'umuntu, MyJudicial itunganya amakuru yawe yisunze ibi bishingiro bikurikira:

• Gusohoza amasezerano (Ingingo ya 46(1)(b)): Itunganywa ry'amakuru ni ngombwa kugira ngo dusohoze amasezerano y'imikoranire twagiranye nawe (amabwiriza y'urubuga, gufata gahunda y'ubujyanama, kubika amafaranga muri escrow, no gukoresha ububiko bw'inyandiko).
• Kubahiriza inshingano z'amategeko (Ingingo ya 46(1)(c)): Amategeko y'ubucuruzi mu Rwanda, kubika inyandiko z'ibaruramari, kurwanya iyezandonke, gutanga umusoro mu Kigo cy'Imisoro n'Amahoro (RRA), no kubahiriza amabwiriza y'inkiko z'u Rwanda.
• Inyungu zemewe n'amategeko (Ingingo ya 46(1)(f)): Inyungu z'ubucuruzi bwemewe za MyJudicial n'iz'abakoresha urubuga—by'umwihariko kugenzura niba abavoka banditse ku Rutonde rw'Urugaga, gukumira uburiganya, kurinda umutekano w'urubuga, no kubika inyandiko z'ibyakozwe (AuditLog)—igihe cyose bitabangamiye uburenganzira bwawe shingiro.
• Uburenganzira butanzwe na nyir'ubwite (Ingingo ya 46(1)(a)): Ku bintu bimwe na bimwe bitari itegeko, tugusaba uburenganzira busobanutse, nko gutanga amakuru y'aho uherereye kugira ngo ubone abavoka bakwegereye, cyangwa gukoresha ijwi mu kwandika ikibazo cyawe hifashishijwe AI. Ushobora guhagarika ubu burenganzira igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

sections.title: 7. Abahabwa Amakuru n'Uko Asangizwa
sections.text:
Ntabwo ducuruza, ntitukodesha, kandi ntitugurisha amakuru yawe bwite na rimwe. Amakuru asangizwa gusa ibi byiciro bikurikira byateganyijwe:

• Abavoka wahisemo kugisha inama: Iyo ufashe gahunda yo kugisha inama umwavoka, amakuru yawe, incamake y'ikibazo, n'inyandiko wageneye uwo mwavoka bimugeraho mu buryo butaziguye.
• Abafatanyabikorwa mu by'ikoranabuhanga n'ububiko bwo mu bicu:
  - Ububiko bw'amakuru n'imyirondoro: Supabase / Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  - Ububiko bufunze bw'inyandiko (Vault): Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) hamwe n'uburyo bwo gucunga imfunguzo za KMS.
  - Amashusho yo kugisha inama mu buryo bw'ako kanya: LiveKit Cloud ikoresha uburyo bwa WebRTC bufite umutekano ukomeye.
  - Kohereza ubutumwa: Brevo ikoreshwa mu kohereza imeri na SMS zibutsa gahunda cyangwa zitanga imibare y'umutekano (OTP).
  - Kubika amakuru akenerwa vuba: Upstash Redis.
  - Kumenyekanisha no kwishyura amafaranga: AzamPay ifasha mu kwakira no kwishyura amafaranga ya Mobile Money.
• Urugaga rw'Abavoka mu Rwanda: Igihe bikenewe mu gusuzuma niba umwavoka yemewe cyangwa mu gukurikirana imyitwarire ye mu mwuga.
• Inkiko n'Inzego z'Ubutabera: Igihe gusa bitetswe n'icyemezo cy'urukiko cyangwa itegeko ryatanzwe n'inzego z'ubutabera zibifitiye ububasha mu Rwanda.

sections.title: 8. Ibanga ry'Umwuga w'Ubuvoka no Kwizerana
sections.text:
Ibanga ry'umwuga w'ubuvoka (Professional Secrecy): Mu mategeko y'u Rwanda no mu mahame agenga Urugaga rw'Abavoka, amakuru n'inyandiko uhereza umwavoka mu gihe umugisha inama bigengwa n'ibanga rikomeye ry'umwuga (secret professionnel). Umwavoka ugishije inama afite inshingano ikomeye yo kutamena ibanga ku byo wamubwiye byose.

Ingamba z'umutekano ku rubuga: MyJudicial yubatse mu buryo bwubahiriza iri banga ry'umwuga. Inyandiko zishyirwa mu bubiko bw'ibanga (Vault) zifungwa n'ingufuri ya AES-256-GCM ku buryo n'abakozi ba MyJudicial ubwabo badashobora kuzisoma cyangwa kureba ubutumwa ugirana n'umwavoka, keretse gusa igihe habayeho ikibazo cy'ikoranabuhanga gikenera gukemurwa kandi bikagenzurwa n'amategeko, cyangwa hateganyijwe n'icyemezo cy'urukiko.

sections.title: 9. Imikoreshereze ya AI n'Umutekano wayo
sections.text:
MyJudicial ikoresha ikoranabuhanga rya AI (myjudicial-ai-service) mu gufasha abaturage gusobanukirwa ibyiciro by'ibibazo byabo:

• Guhindura ijwi mu nyandiko (Whisper): Iyo ufashe amajwi usobanura ikibazo cyawe, porogaramu ya Whisper ihindura iryo jwi mu magambo mu kanya gato. Iryo jwi ntiriguma ku rubuga nyuma yo kwandikwa.
• Gutahura urwego rw'amategeko: Porogaramu yacu isesengura amagambo (Ollama Qwen2.5 cyangwa cloud yizewe) isuzuma ikibazo cyawe kugira ngo imenye niba kireba amategeko y'ubutaka, umuryango, ubucuruzi, cyangwa ibindi, ndetse ikerekana niba cyihutirwa.
• Gushakisha umwavoka uhuye n'ikibazo: Amagambo asobanura ikibazo ahindurwamo imibare y'ikoranabuhanga (embeddings) ifasha kubona umwavoka ufite ubunararibonye mu bibazo nk'ibyo.
• NTA MAKURU AKORESHWA MU KWIGISHA AI: Amakuru y'ibibazo byawe, inyandiko ushyiraho, amajwi wafashe, n'ibiganiro ugirana n'abavoka NTIBYIGISHWA cyangwa ngo bikoreshwe mu kunoza porogaramu za AI z'abandi.
• Ubufasha bwo kuyobora gusa: Ibyo AI yerekana ni ibitekerezo byo kukuyobora ku mwunganizi ukwiye. AI ntabwo itanga inama z'amategeko zemewe kandi ntishobora gusimbura umwavoka wemewe n'amategeko.

sections.title: 10. Imyanzuro Yikora no Guhitamo Abavoka ku Urubuga
11. Amakuru y'Aho Uherereye n'Ikarita
sections.text:
Gushaka abavoka bakwegereye: Kugira ngo ubashe kubona abavoka bafite ibiro hafi y'aho uherereye cyangwa hafi y'urukiko rw'akarere kawe, MyJudicial ifite ikarita ikwereka aho bari. Porogaramu ukoresha igusaba uruhushya gusa igihe ukanze ahanditse gushaka abari hafi yawe.

Aho urubuga rufata igihe utatanze uruhushya: Iyo wanze gutanga uruhushya cyangwa telefoni yawe itabifite, ikarita ifata i Kigali rwagati (Akarere ka Nyarugenge: -1.9441, 30.0619).

Nta gukurikiranwa bihoraho: Amakuru y'aho uherereye akoreshwa mu gihe ushakisha gusa hakoreshejwe uburyo bwa PostGIS ST_DWithin bubara intera iri hagati yawe n'ibiro by'umwavoka. Ntabwo duhora tugukurikirana aho ugiye kandi ayo makuru ntabikwa muri konti yawe.

sections.title: 12. Porogaramu Ntoya Zifashishwa ku Urubuga (Cookies)
sections.text:
Cookies z'ingenzi n'iz'urubuga: Dukoresha cookies z'ingenzi zifasha kwinjira mu buryo bwizewe no kurinda umutekano wa konti yawe (NextAuth, CSRF tokens, na Supabase auth), no gufata mu mutwe ururimi wahisemo (Icyongereza, Igifaransa, cyangwa Ikinyarwanda) hamwe n'uburyo urubuga rugaragaramo (umucyo cyangwa umwijima).

Nta cookies zo kwamamaza z'abandi zikoreshwa: Ntabwo dukoresha cookies z'izindi kompanyi zo gukurikirana ibyo ukora ku zindi mbuga cyangwa kwamamaza.

Politiki yihariye y'Amakuru ya Cookies: Kugira ngo umenye urutonde rwuzuye rwa cookies zikoreshwa, igihe zimaraho, n'uko wazihagarika, wasura Politiki yacu yerekeye Cookies kuri /cookies.

sections.title: 13. Igihe Amakuru Abikwa n'Uburyo Agenzurwa
sections.text:
Igihe cyo kubika amakuru mu mucyo: Tubika amakuru yawe gusa mu gihe gikenewe kugira ngo dusohoze ibyo yafashwe gukora no kubahiriza amategeko y'u Rwanda:

• Konti zigikora: Amakuru yawe y'umwirondoro aguma kuri konti yawe mu gihe cyose igikora kugeza igihe usabye ko ifungwa cyangwa uyisibye ubwawe.
• Inyandiko z'imari n'ibaruramari: Inyemezabwishyu z'ubujyanama, inyandiko z'amafaranga yanyuze muri escrow, n'ibindi byerekeye amafaranga bibikwa imyaka cumi (10) hakurikijwe amategeko y'ubucuruzi n'imisoro mu Rwanda (RRA) no gukumira iyezandonke.
• Inyandiko zo mu bubiko bw'ibanga (Vault): Inyandiko z'imanza washize mu bubiko bwite zigumamo kugeza igihe uzisibiye ubwawe cyangwa ugafunga konti yawe.
• Raporo z'umutekano n'ibikorwa byakozwe: Raporo z'umutekano (AuditLog) zibikwa kugira ngo zifashishwe mu gucunga umutekano no gukumira ibitero by'ikoranabuhanga n'uburiganya.
• Gahunda y'Igenzura: Dukurikije amabwiriza y'Ibiro bishinzwe Kurinda Amakuru (DPO Rwanda), MyJudicial irimo gushyiraho uburyo bwikora bwo gusiba amakuru y'igihe gito igihe cyateganyijwe n'amategeko kirangiye.

sections.title: 14. Ingamba z'Umutekano mu By'Ikoranabuhanga no mu Mikorere
sections.text:
Twashyizeho ingamba zikomeye z'umutekano w'ikoranabuhanga kugira ngo amakuru yawe bwite atazimira, atakoreshwa cyangwa ngo aboneke ku batabifitiye uburenganzira:

• Gufunga amakuru mu gihe ari mu nzira (TLS 1.3): Ibyohererezwa byose hagati ya telefone cyangwa mudasobwa yawe na seriveri zacu bifunze n'ingufuri ya HTTPS/TLS 1.3.
• Gufunga inyandiko zo mu bubiko (AES-256-GCM): Inyandiko zose zishyirwa mu bubiko bwa OCI zifungwa n'ingufuri ikomeye ya AES-256-GCM hakoreshejwe imfunguzo zicungwa na OCI Key Management Service (KMS).
• Kurinda ijambobanga: Amagambobanga afungwa n'imibare y'ikoranabuhanga ya Argon2/bcrypt; nta mukozi n'umwe ushobora kubona ijambobanga ryawe.
• Kugenzura uburenganzira bw'abinjira (RBAC): Urubuga rwashyizweho mu buryo butandukanya Umuturage, Impuguke, n'Umuyobozi, ku buryo nta wureba amakuru atamureba.
• Kubika raporo z'ibyabaye byose (AuditLog): Ibikorwa byose by'ingenzi (kwinjira, kwemeza ibyangombwa by'umwavoka, kureba inyandiko, gutanga amafaranga) byandikwa muri raporo z'umutekano zigaragaza igihe byakorewe n'aho byakorewe.

sections.title: 15. Kohereza Amakuru Hanze y'u Rwanda (Ingingo ya 40-42)
16. Uburenganzira Bwawe ku Makuru Bwite (Itegeko nº 058/2021)
sections.text:
Nk'uko biteganywa n'Itegeko ry'u Rwanda nº 058/2021, ufite uburenganzira bukurikira ku makuru yawe bwite:

• Uburenganzira bwo kumenyeshwa (Ingingo ya 15 na 16): Kumenya mu buryo busobanutse uko amakuru yawe akusanywa n'uko akoreshwa.
• Uburenganzira bwo kugera ku makuru (Ingingo ya 16): Gusaba kumenya amakuru tugufiteho no guhabwa kopi yayo yanditse neza.
• Uburenganzira bwo gukosora amakuru (Ingingo ya 18): Gusaba ko amakuru atari yo cyangwa aduzuye akosorwa ako kanya. Ushobora no guhindura amakuru amwe n'amwe mu mwirondoro wawe kuri konti.
• Uburenganzira bwo gusiba amakuru (Ingingo ya 19): Gusaba ko amakuru yawe asibwa burundu mu gihe amasezerano yarangiye cyangwa waretse gukoresha serivisi, keretse igihe amategeko y'imisoro n'ubucuruzi ategeka ko agomba kubikwa.
• Uburenganzira bwo guhagarika by'agateganyo ikoreshwa ry'amakuru (Ingingo ya 20): Gusaba ko amakuru yawe aba ahagaritswe gukoreshwa mu gihe hari ibikigenzurwa.
• Uburenganzira bwo kwimukana amakuru (Ingingo ya 21): Guhabwa amakuru yawe mu buryo bworoshye bwo kuyashyira ku wundi mutanga-serivisi.
• Uburenganzira bwo kwanga ko amakuru akoreshwa (Ingingo ya 22): Kwanga ko amakuru yawe akoreshwa mu bintu bidakenewe.
• Uburenganzira bwo kwisubiraho ku burenganzira watanze (Ingingo ya 46): Guhagarika uburenganzira wari waratanze igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.

Uko wakoresha uburenganzira bwawe: Ohereza ubusabe bwawe mu nyandiko ku Mukozi ushinzwe Kurinda Amakuru (DPO) kuri imeri {{dpoEmail}}. Kugira ngo turinde umutekano wawe, dushobora kugusaba kwerekana ibikuranga. Tuzakira ubusabe bwawe kandi tuguhe igisubizo mu gihe kitarenze iminsi mirongo itatu (30) iteganywa n'Itegeko nº 058/2021.

sections.title: 17. Kurinda Amakuru y'Abana (Abari Munsi y'Imyaka 18)
sections.text:
Imyaka 18 yo gukoresha urubuga: Urubuga rwa MyJudicial rwateganyirijwe gusa abantu bagejeje ku myaka cumi n'umunani (18) y'amavuko bafite ubushobozi bw'amategeko bwo kugira amasezerano bakurikije amategeko y'u Rwanda.

Abana bakeneye serivisi z'amategeko: Dukurikije Ingingo ya 9 y'Itegeko nº 058/2021, amakuru y'umwana ntashobora gutunganywa hatanzwe uburenganzira n'umubyeyi cyangwa umurezi we wemewe n'amategeko. Iyo hakenewe ubufasha bw'amategeko ku mwana (nk'urugero mu bibazo by'umuryango cyangwa izungura), iyo serivisi igomba gutangizwa kandi igacungwa n'umubyeyi cyangwa umwishingizi we. Iyo dusanze hari umwana wiyandikishije atabiherewe uburenganzira n'umubyeyi, konti ye ihita ifungwa n'amakuru ye agasibwa.

sections.title: 18. Ubutumwa bwa Serivisi n'Ubutumwa bwo Kumenyekanisha
sections.text:
Ubutumwa bwa serivisi bwa ngombwa: Tukwoherereza ubutumwa bwa SMS na imeri bukenewe mu gutanga serivisi, nk'ubutumwa bwibutsa gahunda yo guhura n'umwavoka, imibare y'umutekano (OTP), inyemezabwishyu, n'ubutumwa bw'umutekano wa konti. Ubu butumwa ni ngombwa cyane ku mutekano no ku mikorere ya konti yawe, ku buryo utabuhagarika mu gihe ugikoresha urubuga.

Ubutumwa bwo kumenyekanisha ibikorwa bishya: Iyo dushaka kukwoherereza inyandiko zigisha amategeko cyangwa amakuru y'ibikorwa bishya, tubanza kugusaba uburenganzira. Buri butumwa bufite ahanditse gukuramo izina ryawe (unsubscribe) kugira ngo uhagarike kububona igihe cyose ubyifuje.

sections.title: 19. Izindi Mbuga n'Amasosiyete Dukorana
sections.text:
Imbuga z'abandi ziriho links: Urubuga rwa MyJudicial rushobora gushyiraho links zikwerekeza ku zindi mbuga z'abafatanyabikorwa, nk'Urugaga rw'Abavoka mu Rwanda (rwanda-bar.org), imbuga z'inkiko z'u Rwanda, cyangwa imbuga z'ibigo by'ubwishyu.

Kwigenga kw'izo mbuga: MyJudicial nta bubasha ifite ku mikorere y'izo mbuga z'abandi cyangwa uburyo zicungamo amakuru yazo. Iyo ukanze kuri izo links uba ugiye ku yindi mbuga, bityo turakugira inama yo gusoma amabwiriza yazo y'ibanga.

sections.title: 20. Gukemura Ibibazo by'Umutekano no Kumenyesha Abagize Ikibazo
sections.text:
Guhangana n'ibitero by'umutekano: MyJudicial ifite amabwiriza asobanutse agenga uburyo bwo gutahura no gukemura vuba ikibazo icyo ari cyo cyose cy'umutekano w'amakuru.

Kumenyesha inzego z'ubutabera mu masaha 48: Hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 43 y'Itegeko nº 058/2021, igihe habayeho ikibazo cy'itakara cyangwa ivumburwa ry'amakuru bwite, MyJudicial izabimenyesha Ikigo cy'Igihugu gishinzwe Umutekano w'Ikoranabuhanga / Ibiro bishinzwe Kurinda Amakuru (NCSA DPO) mu masaha adarenga mirongo ine n'umunani (48) bimenyekanye.

Kumenyesha abaturage bagize ikibazo: Hakurikijwe Ingingo ya 44 y'iryo tegeko, niba icyo kibazo gishobora guteza inkurikizi mbi ku burenganzira bwawe, tuzahita tukubimenyesha vuba bishoboka tukanakwereka ingamba zafashwe zo kugikemura n'icyo wakora ngo wikingire.

sections.title: 21. Kugeza Ikirego mu Nzego Zibifitiye Ububasha (NCSA / DPO Rwanda)
sections.text:
Kubanza kutumenyesha: Icyo ari cyo cyose utishimiye ku micungire y'amakuru yawe, turakugira inama yo kubanza kutwandikira kuri imeri y'Ushinzwe Kurinda Amakuru (DPO) kuri {{dpoEmail}}.

Uburenganzira bwo gutanga ikirego mu buyobozi: Ufite uburenganzira buteganywa n'Itegeko nº 058/2021 bwo kugeza ikirego mu Kigo cy'Igihugu gishinzwe gukurikirana iby'ikoranabuhanga no kurinda amakuru bwite mu Rwanda:

National Cyber Security Authority (NCSA)
Data Protection Office (DPO)
Urubuga rwa interineti: https://dpo.gov.rw
Imeri: dpo@ncsa.gov.rw
Aho giherereye: Kigali, Repubulika y'u Rwanda

sections.title: 22. Ivugururwa ry'Iyi Politiki n'Ibyahindutse
sections.text:
Ivugururwa rihoraho: Dushobora kuvugurura iyi Politiki y'Ibanga igihe hari ibyahindutse mu ikoranabuhanga, mu mikorere y'urubuga, cyangwa mu mabwiriza atangwa n'Ibiro bishinzwe Kurinda Amakuru.

Itariki yo kuvugurura: Itariki igaragara hejuru ku rupapuro yerekana igihe aya mabwiriza aherukira kuvugururwa no gutangira gukurikizwa.

Kumenyesha impinduka zikomeye: Iyo habayeho impinduka zikomeye zireba uburenganzira bwawe, tuzakubimenyesha binyuze mu butumwa bwo ku rubuga cyangwa kuri imeri yawe mbere y'uko izo mpinduka zitangira gukurikizwa. Inyandiko z'ubushize zibikwa mu buryo bw'ikoranabuhanga kandi ushobora kuzisaba ukazihabwa.

faqs.title: Ibibazo Bikunze Kubazwa ku Biciro n'Ubwishyu
faqs.subtitle: Ibisubizo bisobanutse ku bijyanye n'amafaranga, ubwishyu, n'ubwirinzi bwacu.
faqs.q1: Ibiciro bya serivisi z'amategeko bigenwa gute?
faqs.a1: Buri mwavoka wemewe agena ku giti cye ibiciro bye bihamye kuri MyJudicial ashingiye ku bunararibonye bwe, ubuhanga mu mwuga, n'igihe cyo gutegura dosiye. Buri serivisi igira igihe n'intego bisobanutse neza.
faqs.q2: Ese nshobora kumenya igiciro nyacyo mbere yo gufata gahunda?
faqs.a2: Yego. Burigihe ubona igiciro cyose mu Mafaranga y'u Rwanda (RWF), igihe inama izamara, n'uburyo izakorwamo mbere yo kwemeza cyangwa kwishyura.
faqs.q3: Ni iki gikubiye mu giciro kigaragazwa?
faqs.a3: Igiciro kigaragazwa gikubiyemo igihe cyose cy'inama, gusuzuma inyandiko zatanzwe mbere, ihuza rishingiye ku mutekano (amashusho cyangwa telefoni), hamwe n'ubwirinzi bw'ubwishyu. Nta mafaranga y'inyongera yongerwaho mu kwishyura.
faqs.q4: Ese umwavoka ashobora guhindura igiciro nyuma yo gufata gahunda?
faqs.a4: Ntibyemewe na gato ku nama yamaze kwemezwa. Igiciro mwemeranyijweho kigomba kubahirizwa. Niba mwifuza gukomeza kumushyiraho mu manza z'urukiko cyangwa indi mirimo itandukanye, azaguha inyandiko y'ibiciro yihariye.
faqs.q5: Kwishyura ukoresheje Mobile Money mu Rwanda bikora gute?
faqs.a5: Dufatanyije na AzamPay itanga uburyo bwihuse bwo kwishyura bwa Mobile Money. Mu gihe cyo kwishyura, andika nimero yawe ya MTN (078/079) cyangwa Airtel (072/073). Uhita wakira ubutumwa (USSD) kuri telefoni yawe busaba gushyiramo umubare w'ibanga (PIN) kugira ngo wemeze ubwishyu.
faqs.q6: Ubwirinzi bw'ubwishyu (escrow) busobanura iki kuri MyJudicial?
faqs.a6: Bivuze ko amafaranga yawe adahita ahabwa umwavoka mbere y'igihe. Amafaranga arindirwa mu mutekano n'urubuga kugeza inama irangiye neza. Umwavoka ahabwa igihembo cye nyuma yo gusohoza inama.
faqs.q7: Bigenda bite iyo nifuza guhagarika gahunda cyangwa umwavoka ntiyitabire?
faqs.a7: Iyo umwavoka ahagaritse inama cyangwa ntiyitabire, uhita usubizwa 100% by'amafaranga yawe kuri konti yawe ya Mobile Money ako kanya. Ushobora kandi guhindura isaha y'inama n'umwavoka mbere y'uko igihe kigera nta bihano.
faqs.q8: Ese hari andi mafaranga yihishe cyangwa fagitire zitunguranye?
faqs.a8: Nta na make. MyJudicial ikuraho ibiciro bibarirwa ku masaha bitazwi iherezo, ingwate zidasobanutse, n'amafaranga y'inyongera mu kwishyura. Icyo ubonye ni cyo wishyura nta gihindutse.

meta.description: Menya amahirwe yo kubaka ikoranabuhanga ry'amategeko ryoroshye kandi riboneye mu Rwanda hamwe na MyJudicial.

hero.title: Kubaka ejo hazaza ha serivisi z'ubutabera zibereye bose
hero.subtitle: Fatanya n'ikipe y'abahanga ikora ku kwinjiza impinduka mu kubona serivisi z'amategeko mu Rwanda, binyuze mu ikoranabuhanga rihanitse, ibiciro bisobanutse, no kugenzura by'ukuri abavoka.

hero.hiringSubPaused: Kwakira abakozi bishyizwe ku ruhande; ubusabe rusange buracyakirwa

whyMyJudicial.title: Impamvu yo kubakana na MyJudicial
whyMyJudicial.subtitle: Kora ku ikoranabuhanga rikemura ikibazo gikomeye: kubona no kwishyura umuvoka wemewe nta gutinya cyangwa kuremerwa n'ibiciro bitazwi.

access.title: Ubutabera bugera kuri bose
access.desc: Umuntu wese, n'iyo yaba ari hanze ya Kigali kandi nta muntu aziranye na we mu mategeko, ashobora gushakisha umuvoka, kureba igiciro cyo kuganira kigengwa neza, no gukoresha ururimi rwe.

transparency.title: Ibisobanuro by'ibiciro biboneye
transparency.desc: Igiciro cy'inama n'umuvoka kimenyekana mbere yo kwiyemeza. Amafaranga yishyuwe arindirwa muri sisitemu y'ubwishingizi (escrow) kugeza inama irangiye, cyangwa agasubizwa umukiriya.

verification.title: Isuzuma ryimbitse ry'abavoka
verification.desc: Buri muvoka aca mu isuzuma rikomeye rigizwe n'ibyiciro byinshi, rihuzwa n'Urutonde Rwemewe rw'Urugaga rw'Abavoka mu Rwanda (RBA) hamwe n'indangamuntu y'igihugu.

impact.title: Impinduka ifatika mu baturage
impact.desc: Umurimo wacu ugaragarira mu kurengera abaturage n'ubucuruzi binyuze mu guhabwa inama z'amategeko zizewe, mu cyubahiro no ku biciro biboneye.

whatWeWorkOn.title: Ibyo twibandaho mu kazi
whatWeWorkOn.subtitle: Inkingi zikomeye z'ikoranabuhanga n'imikorere biha ubutabera imbaraga zo kugera kuri buri wese.

marketplace.title: Isoko n'Ishakiro ry'Abavoka
marketplace.desc: Gushakisha ku ikarita no mu magambo, ukoresheje amashami y'amategeko, ibiciro byashyizweho, amanota y'abakiriya, n'amasaha yo kuboneka.

payments.title: Kwishyura no Kurinda Amafaranga
payments.desc: Kwishyura byihuse ukoresheje Mobile Money cyangwa amakarita binyuze mu bigo byemewe, ububiko bwa escrow burinda amafaranga, no gusubiza amafaranga mu buryo bwizewe.

ai.title: Gusesengura Ikibazo hifashishijwe AI
ai.desc: Umuntu asobanura ikibazo cye mu magambo ye, AI ikacyumva, ikagaragaza ishami ry'amategeko ribereye, uburemere bwacyo, n'abavoka babishoboye.

video.title: Ibiganiro bya Video bifite Umutekano
video.desc: Ibiganiro bya WebRTC byihuse kandi bidaheza, biboneka gusa hagati y'umukiriya n'umuvoka we nta gufata amajwi cyangwa amashusho kuri seriveri.

verification.title: Igenzura ry'Ibyangombwa n'Amategeko
verification.desc: Ibyangombwa n'impamyabumenyi bibikwa mu buryo bwisumbuye (AES-256), bikagenzurwa byihariye, kandi buri cyemezo kigahamywa mu nyandiko zidakorwaho.

localization.title: Urubuga mu Ndimi Ebyiri n'Ikinyarwanda
localization.desc: Urubuga rukora mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza, n'Igifaransa ku buryo bunoze kugira ngo ubutabera bwumvikane kuri bose.

benefits.title: Byateguriwe Abahanga Bashaka Gutanga Umusanzu
benefits.subtitle: Twemera ko abakozi b'abahanga bakwiye imishahara myiza, uburenganzira bwo gutekereza, n'ibikoresho byiza byo gukora akazi k'indashyikirwa.

compensation.title: Umushahara Uhagaze Neza
compensation.desc: Imishahara igereranije n'urwego rwo hejuru mu karere, hamwe n'agahimbazamushyi k'imikorere n'imigabane muri sosiyete.

health.title: Ubwishingizi bw'Ubuzima Bwuzuye
health.desc: Ubwishingizi bwo ku rwego rwo hejuru bwo kwivuza no kwisuzumisha amenyo, bukurikirana wowe n'umuryango wawe mu mavuriro akomeye mu Rwanda.

hardware.title: Ibikoresho by'Akazi Byiza
hardware.desc: Uhitamo hagati ya Apple MacBook Pro nshya cyangwa Lenovo ThinkPad, amashusho ya 4K, n'intebe n'ameza biboneye.

office.title: Ibiro i Kigali CBD no Gukorera Aho Ushaka
office.desc: Ibiro bigezweho muri Deco Center mu mujyi wa Kigali rwagati, hamwe n'amahitamo yo gukorera mu rugo cyangwa ku biro mu buryo bworoheje.

growth.title: Amasomo no Kwishyurirwa Ibirango by'Umwuga
growth.desc: Amafaranga yagenewe kongera ubumenyi, inama mpuzamahanga, no kwishyurirwa imisanzu y'umwuga w'abavoka n'abubatsi b'ikoranabuhanga.

impact.title: Impinduka Ikomeye mu Butabera
impact.desc: Gufasha ibihumbi by'abaturage n'amasosiyete gukemura ibibazo by'amategeko mu mutekano, icyubahiro n'ubutabera buboneye.

howWeWork.title: Uburyo dukora akazi
howWeWork.subtitle: Amahame y'ukuri tugenderaho mu gufata ibyemezo buri munsi.

p1.title: Umuturage uza mbere
p1.desc: Impinduka ifite akamaro niba ikuraho ikibazo cyangwa urujijo ku muntu ushaka ubufasha mu mategeko. Niba itabikora, ntikwiye gukoreshwa.

p2.title: Kubaka mu mutekano no kurinda ibanga
p2.desc: Ibibazo by'amategeko birakomeye. Twita cyane ku mutekano no kurinda amakuru y'abantu, nk'uko bisobanurwa mu mategeko agenga ububiko bwacu.

p3.title: Icyizere kishingiye ku kuri
p3.desc: Dukora isuzuma rikomeye kandi ntitwizeza ibitari byo. Twahitamo kuba inyangamugayo ku byo urubuga rukora aho kurata ibyo rudashoboye.

p4.title: Gukemura ibibazo bifatika
p4.desc: Dukunda ibikora neza kuri telefone isanzwe no ku murongo w'itumanaho usanzwe mu Rwanda, aho gukora gusa ibyerekana ubwiza bwa demo.

openings.subtitle: Reba imyanya y'akazi ikenewe cyangwa wohereze ubusabe rusange.
openings.emptyFiltered: Nta mwanya w'akazi uhari muri iri shami. Reba andi mashami cyangwa wohereze ubusabe rusange.

empty.subtitle: Nta mwanya uratangazwa ubu. Niba wifuza kuzakorana natwe, ushobora kutwoherereza ubusabe rusange kugira ngo tuzagufatireho umwanzuro.

faqs.title: Ibibazo bikunze kubazwa
faqs.subtitle: Ibyo wifuza kumenya byose ku bijyanye no gukora muri MyJudicial.
faqs.a1: MyJudicial ifite ibiro bikuru mu mujyi wa Kigali, mu Rwanda, mu gace k'ubucuruzi n'imari.
faqs.q2: Nshobora kwohereza ubusabe n'iyo nta mwanya w'akazi watangajwe?
faqs.a2: Yego rwose. Ushobora kwohereza ubusabe rusange cyangwa kwandikira careers@myjudicial.com. Ikipe yacu isuzuma buri mwirondoro wakiriwe.
faqs.q3: Ni iki ngomba gushyira mu busabe bwanjye?
faqs.a3: Aderesi ya CV yawe, konti ya LinkedIn cyangwa GitHub, n'ibaruwa ngufi isobanura ibyo wifuza gukora muri MyJudicial.
faqs.a4: Urubuga rukoreshwa mu buryo bunoze mu Kinyarwanda, Icyongereza n'Igifaransa mu gushakisha no gutumiza inama zose z'abavoka.

cta.title: Witeguye kubaka ejo hazaza h'ubutabera?
cta.subtitle: Reba imyanya ihari, ohereza ubusabe rusange, cyangwa umenye byinshi ku ntego za sosiyete yacu.
